svg.aria-label: How Open Forge fits together. At startup the agent reads AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md, the loader, the indexes of Directives, Guidance, Patterns, Skills, Maps, Memory, Working, Emerging, and Crystallized, and the CLI usage Skill explicitly required by the Skills index. Other linked files open when selected, tagged to load, or required by a loaded rule. Templates and Archived open on demand. A file with applyTo patterns applies only while the task works on a matching file. Core holds six categories for how work gets done. Memory holds four states for what's worth remembering. Cards include examples of optional Extension content, such as Checkpoints and Decisions.

text.tspan: Linked files open when selected or required. #LoadNow reads a file when its parent index loads; #KeepInMind also
re-reads it at task start or resume, after a context restore, and before handoff or closeout while its scope is
active. Both tags act through a loaded parent. The Skills rules explicitly require the CLI usage guide at startup.
